# Game of Bones

Game of Bones is an Indian pet-treat brand making single-ingredient, naturally dehydrated treats for dogs and cats in Kalyan West, Maharashtra (421301). Every treat is one named ingredient — chicken, goat, buffalo or fish — with nothing else added: no preservatives, fillers, salt, sugar or colours. Treats are slow-dehydrated at low heat. Orders ship across India.

## Key facts

- Website: https://gameofbones.in/
- Location: Kalyan West, Thane District, Maharashtra, India
- Ships to: all of India
- Customer support: WhatsApp +91 90825 03295 · helpgameofbones@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gameofbones.in/
- Price, pack size and stock: always use the current product page
- Shipping, returns and privacy: https://gameofbones.in/policies

## Products

### Jerky and training treats

- [Chicken Jerky](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-jerky): Slow-dried chicken breast jerky for dogs. One ingredient, no preservatives, easy to break into small training rewards.
- [Chicken Bites](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-bites): Ready-cut dehydrated chicken pieces for training rewards. Single ingredient, lean, no preservatives.
- [Buff Jerky (buffalo)](https://gameofbones.in/products/buff-jerky): Single-ingredient buffalo jerky for dogs, a different protein for picky eaters and chicken-sensitive dogs. No preservatives.

### Natural chews

- [Chicken Feet](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-feet): Whole dehydrated chicken feet: a natural crunchy chew with cartilage and collagen. Single ingredient, no additives.
- [Chicken Neck](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-neck): Slow-dried chicken necks for medium and large dogs. A meaty, crunchy single-ingredient chew.
- [Chicken Wings](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-wings): Crunchy slow-dried chicken wings for medium and large dogs. Single ingredient.
- [Chicken Wing Tips](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-wing-tips): Small dehydrated chicken wing tips: a light, crunchy single-ingredient chew for small and medium dogs.
- [Chicken Bones](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-bones): Slow-dried chicken bone pieces for dogs who love to crunch. Single ingredient, nothing added.
- [Goat Trachea](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-trachea): Dehydrated goat trachea: a crunchy cartilage chew for dogs, naturally containing glucosamine and chondroitin. Single ingredient.
- [Goat Trotter](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-trotter): Dense, long-lasting dehydrated goat trotter for strong chewers. Single ingredient, rich in natural collagen.
- [Goat Ear](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-ear): Thin, crunchy dehydrated goat ears: a low-fat single-ingredient chew suited to small and senior dogs.

### Organ treats

- [Chicken Gizzards](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-gizzards): Dehydrated chicken gizzards: lean, chewy, high-protein rewards with natural iron and zinc. Single ingredient.
- [Chicken Heart & Liver](https://gameofbones.in/products/chicken-heart-and-liver): Dehydrated chicken heart and liver: nutrient-dense, high-value rewards with natural taurine, vitamin A and B12.
- [Goat Liver](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-liver): Dehydrated goat liver, the high-value training reward. Naturally rich in vitamin A, B12 and iron; give in small pieces.
- [Goat Lungs](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-lungs): Light, airy dehydrated goat lungs: a low-fat, crumbly reward that's easy to break for small dogs and puppies.
- [Goat Heart & Kidney Mix](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-heart-and-kidney-mix): Dehydrated goat heart and kidney: a meaty organ mix with natural taurine, B vitamins and iron. Single-ingredient treats made in Kalyan, India.
- [Goat Spleen](https://gameofbones.in/products/goat-spleen): Dehydrated goat spleen, an iron-rich organ treat with a deep meaty taste dogs love. Single ingredient, no additives.

### Fish treats (dogs and cats)

- [Anchovies](https://gameofbones.in/products/anchovies): Whole dried anchovies for dogs and cats: crunchy, low-mercury small fish with natural omega-3. Single ingredient.
- [Sardines](https://gameofbones.in/products/sardines): Whole dried sardines for dogs and cats: low-mercury small fish with natural omega-3 and calcium. Single ingredient.
- [White Sardines](https://gameofbones.in/products/white-sardines): Small whole white sardines, dried: a light fish treat for dogs and cats with natural omega-3. Single ingredient.
- [Bombay Duck (Bombil)](https://gameofbones.in/products/bombay-duck): Dried Bombil, the Mumbai favourite: a light, low-fat, high-protein fish treat for dogs and cats. Single ingredient.
- [Tuna](https://gameofbones.in/products/tuna): Dehydrated tuna pieces for dogs and cats: lean, high-protein and irresistible. An occasional single-ingredient treat.
- [Mackerel Fillet](https://gameofbones.in/products/mackerel-fillet): Boneless dehydrated mackerel fillet for dogs and cats: an oily fish reward with natural omega-3. Single ingredient.
- [Whole Mackerel](https://gameofbones.in/products/whole-mackerel): Whole dehydrated mackerel for medium and large dogs: oily fish with natural omega-3, meat and bone together.
- [Prawns](https://gameofbones.in/products/prawns): Dehydrated prawns: a crunchy, low-fat special treat for dogs and cats, with natural B12. Single ingredient.

### Whole prey

- [Whole Quail](https://gameofbones.in/products/whole-quail): A whole dehydrated quail with meat, bone and organs: a novel-protein, whole-prey chew for medium and large dogs.

### Boxes and bundles

- [Cat Trial Box](https://gameofbones.in/products/cat-trial-box): Five single-ingredient fish treats in one box to find what your cat loves. Natural, no additives.
- [Small Treat Box](https://gameofbones.in/products/small-treat-box): Nine labelled mini packs of single-ingredient dog treats to find your dog's favourite before buying full packs.
- [Medium Treat Box](https://gameofbones.in/products/medium-treat-box): Seven full packs of single-ingredient dog treats across chicken, goat, fish and chews: about a month of variety.
- [Large Treat Box](https://gameofbones.in/products/large-treat-box): Ten full packs of single-ingredient dog treats for multi-dog homes, big appetites or gifting. Our best value box.
- [Surprise Me Box](https://gameofbones.in/products/surprise-me-box): A surprise mix of single-ingredient dog treats and chews across chicken, goat and fish. A fun gift for dogs.

## Editorial standards

Game of Bones content is educational and is not veterinary diagnosis or treatment advice. Treats are not a complete meal; vets suggest treats stay within about 10% of a pet's daily food. For a pet with a health condition, food sensitivity or a material diet change, consult a qualified veterinarian.
